reviews.name: devyn castel
reviews.text:
I couldn’t be happier with Buzz Off Pest Prevention as a low tox living family!! I’m sooo happy they’re in the OC area!! Knowing their method is all natural, no greenwashing,  there really is so much peace of mind as a mom and dog mom and family that loves to host! I feel confident in knowing our family and friends aren’t being harmed by harmful chemicals while also being able to enjoy our outdoor space.

Maurice serviced our home, both front and backyard so thoroughly! From experience with past companies, it feels like they do a brief sweep and spray, but not with Buzz Off! Maurice took the time to get every area and used two separate methods for spider control and mosquito control which we deal A LOT with where we live. I also am a huge customer service fan and really appreciated how attentive and friendly Maurice was.

I’d without a doubt recommend Buzz Off to every OC family or anyone looking for a mindful living pest control company!

reviews.name: cory frino
reviews.text: Great mosquito service from Spray Buzz Off! They showed up on time, extremely friendly and were easy to work with. We can’t wait to finally enjoy our yard. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Marina Topp
reviews.text: We just had our first treatment with Buzz Off. Scheduling and communication were easy and great! The biggest issue we’ve had with pest control in the past is receiving less than we’d hoped. Our previous company would be in and out in 15 minutes and our home would still have spider webs and eggs everywhere! Maurice with Buzz Off was at our home almost an hour and a half, and our home and yard look great! It is also so reassuring to know that the products used are clean and safe for my little boys as well as my pets!

reviews.name: Ariel Rae Esparza
reviews.text: Professional work, love the attention to detail and care they provided. We were dealing with spiders and ants and have such a peace of mind after they left that the products used are non toxic.

reviews.name: Alexandra T.
reviews.text: Maurice and the team are wonderful. The treatment is so effective and it leaves our yard smelling of beautiful and fresh essential oils.

reviews.name: Jill Gutierrez
reviews.text: We were thoroughly impressed with Maurice & the job he did at our home. He took his time and was incredibly thorough. He walked us through the areas of concern so we could see what was going on. We will definitely be hiring Buzz Off Pest Prevention again.

reviews.name: Scott & Ashley Mann
reviews.text: Maurice was awesome! Super friendly, on time and efficient. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Hailey Garcia
reviews.text: Had the best experience with buzz off pest prevention! Love that it’s natural and non toxic. The customer service was amazing

reviews.name: Delaney Buck
reviews.text: We had such an incredible and informative experience! The peace of mind knowing our mosquito problem is being handled in a safe way for our kids all while still being effective is amazing. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Sandy Janes
reviews.text: Buzz Off has been a game changer!  We could not sit outside anymore without getting destroyed by bug bites! Since hiring Buzz Off we are able to enjoy being outside again!! Bonus points for being prompt, dependable, nice and friendly guys and the spray smells great! We are truly thankful for this service 😊

reviews.name: Linda Hua
reviews.text: I could not be happier with the service Buzz Off provided. Mo took the time and made the effort to really address our cricket issue. He examined our garage door, walls, and the exterior to pinpoint how to address the problem and then showed my husband everything he was doing, walking him through every step as he methodically flushed them all out of our garage wall! They came out by the droves and it was disgusting, but they were gone within two visits! He was very prompt about scheduling a follow up to make sure the issue was completely solved. Was always super communicative, on time, personable, and so knowledgeable about all things bugs. We could not recommend them more for their expertise and professionalism— and as a bonus, they’re non-toxic!

reviews.name: inspegaget
reviews.text: Great service and on time and professional. I recommend this company for pest control to my other friends and family.

reviews.name: Kristin Hall
reviews.text: Love that buzz off uses clean, quality ingredients. None of the traditional chemicals! I like to be super clean and ingredient conscious especially when its things for my kids. So knowing my kids are safe around their product is all the better! The gentleman who comes to spray is very friendly. Ive been happy with my services and definitely recommend!

reviews.name: chris kemby
reviews.text: This is a new service for us, but we are happy to have it.  We have not had any issues with mosquitos since starting the service and the technician is so nice!  Would definitely recommend this service to others!

reviews.name: Maansi Kolby
reviews.text: Called them and they were able to come out same day to my house! Maurice was so friendly and so thorough! I will definitely be calling them again and have already referred them to local friends.

reviews.name: Poonam Gohil
reviews.text: Maurice came out this morning and did a great job. Super professional and thorough. Can’t speak to results yet since it was just done today but the experience alone earns 5 stars. Will definitely be a repeat customer!

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Buzz Off Natural Pest Prevention today. Maurice was very professional, informative, and took the time to explain everything clearly. After researching different options, we found Buzz Off and really liked that they use plant based products instead of harsh chemicals. We’re excited to finally enjoy our backyard again without worrying about our pets. Highly recommend their service and appreciate the great customer care from Maurice.

Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Chris Mercado
reviews.text: Fantastic local service! Finally a safe alternative for my families home. Thanks Buzzoff!!

reviews.name: Vanessa P. Flach
reviews.text:
As a mom, I’m extremely careful about what I bring into our home and yard, especially when it comes to pest control. There are so many toxic chemicals in them. The fact that Buzz Off is all natural and non toxic made it an easy yes. The mosquitos were relentless and I had to do something, but I wanted peace of mind knowing my kids and dog weren’t being exposed to anything questionable.

I was skeptical, but it worked really well! We noticed a big difference quickly and could finally enjoy being outside again.

If you’re looking for pest control that aligns with a more conscious, non toxic lifestyle, I HIGHLY recommend them!!

reviews.text: Buzz Off came out and treated my backyard and house using natural products. I have yet to see ANY mosquitoes in my back yard since they came by. I chose a natural product because I have a dog and didn’t want to spray anything too harsh. Great service and the natural products smell great!

reviews.name: jose algandar
reviews.text: We used Buzzoff pest control to clear out the bugs around our house and yard.   They were responsive and super helpful.  Really easy to.deal with. There is nothing better than the peace of mind you get knowing you don't have to worry about chemicals around your kids, animals and home.   Highly recommended very satisfied with their service.

reviews.name: Ashlyn Canchola
reviews.text: Buzz Off Pest Prevention was exactly what I was looking for. I love that they use natural, pet-friendly treatments (huge plus for me), and they are a local family owned small business. They provide great customer service!

reviews.name: Julie Sandoval
reviews.text:
Super impressed with BuzzOff.  They came out and inspected my home and provided a plan. They took the time to educate me on the natural products that they use.  Made me feel at ease.  I have 2 active kiddos who love to play in the yard.  We actually had a play date scheduled immediately after they left and I was happy to know I did not need to cancel.

I was most impressed with the treatment to our hedge, where the mosquitoes live.  I have never had any other pest control company offer that.

Excited to continue our pest control service with BuzzOff knowing that our home will be safe from toxic chemicals and my kids can time free around the year
